subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should maintainers require live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merging this session-routing PR, or accept source-level proof only?
rationale: The patch changes message delivery and session-state routing, and automation cannot safely waive the repository proof gate for a Telegram-visible behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing owner-topic delivery with heartbeat isolation enabled before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while maintainers explicitly own the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops messages.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Hold this PR and fold its useful tests into the broader detached-subagent liveness and terminal-delivery design tracked by the related issue.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing owner-topic delivery with heartbeat isolation enabled before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses subagent announce delivery and session-routing behavior where steipete has prior feature-history ownership signals.
